about: High or critical npm advisories that have no fix short of a breaking upgrade, accepted on purpose. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high or critical advisory not listed here, and on any entry past its reviewBy date. Remove an entry as soon as a non-breaking fix exists.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists. It is reached only through tailwindcss 3 (chokidar, micromatch, fast-glob) at build time, matching the repo's own content globs; no reader input ever reaches it. The only fix npm offers is tailwindcss 4, a breaking migration of every stylesheet.
